claims.statement: Discussions centralize project direction/future conversations, announcements, questions, answers and polls without requiring third-party tools; capability description does not prove participation quality, correctness or accepted decision.
Repository discussions suit one-repository topics; organization discussions span repositories. Central conversation location does not require merging function-owned product repos.

Broad any-access user creation/participation and administrator-enable statements omit detailed source-repository/configurable/announcement/managed-user conditions and write-user enablement; preserve scope/authority mismatches rather than infer blanket access.
Pinning, answer marking, locking, conversion and closure are separate management tools, not independent engineering acceptance or universal no-comment enforcement.
Answer marking applies Q&A categories; locked concluded/heated discussions are contextual moderation suggestions, with write-role bypass and explicit authority in detailed guide remaining relevant.
User-defined categories and unqualified repository labels wording coexist with detailed cloud label restrictions and format/role conflicts; parent product metadata does not resolve discrepancies.
External community feedback link and quickstart next step are references, not executed contact, platform activation, adoption or rights assurance.
